description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Planview is hiring a Software Engineer I for its Portfolio Intelligence team. The role contributes to the Insight Engine, building and evaluating services that run insights using data science and LLMs while developing cloud-native engineering skills with mentorship from experienced engineers.
Software Engineer I contributing to C# AWS cloud services for agentic insight execution and evaluation systems

Responsibilities:
• Learn and Contribute•Work on well-defined tasks that build your foundational skills in cloud engineering and agentic systems, using C# on AWS. Contribute to components of the Insight Engine, including the services that run insights and the systems that evaluate them, working alongside data scientists to bring their work to production. Implement features and fixes under the guidance of senior engineers, learning to write clean, testable code that meets team standards. As you grow, you’ll take on increasingly complex work with greater independence
• Build Technical Foundations•Develop proficiency in our stack, including .NET Orleans, AWS Bedrock, PostgreSQL, and Snowflake, along with GenAI-powered development tools and workflows. Learn how highly available, scalable cloud services are designed, and how to tackle challenges like non-deterministic LLM output, eval quality, latency, and governance. Senior engineers will provide mentorship and code review to accelerate your growth
• Collaborate and Communicate•Work closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists, asking questions and seeking feedback to accelerate your learning. Participate in team meetings, code reviews, and technical discussions. Communicate clearly about your progress, blockers, and what you're learning
• Develop Production Awareness•Learn our "You Build It, You Run It" culture by participating in on-call rotations with support from experienced team members. Develop an understanding of how production systems operate, how incidents are handled, and how monitoring and alerting help maintain platform reliability

Requirements:
• 1-2 years of professional software development experience, or a recent graduate with relevant internship or co-op experience
• Proficiency in C# or a similar object-oriented language (such as Java)
• Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases
• Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred) through coursework, personal projects, or prior experience
• Exposure to working with LLMs in agentic development (for example, building agents or using agentic coding tools like Claude Code), through work, coursework, or personal projects
• Familiarity with version control (Git) and basic software development practices, including code review and automated testing
• Foundational knowledge of data structures and algorithms
• Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively
• Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and learn production operations practices

Preferred:
• Experience calling LLM APIs, prompt design, or writing evals
• Experience with Python and the .NET Orleans framework
• Familiarity with REST APIs, and with CI/CD, Docker, and containerization concepts
• Interest in Generative AI and experience using AI-powered coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) for learning and productivity
